name: Protection-panel service AC feeder
summary: Shows the auxiliary AC circuit allocated to protection-panel service functions.
description: Shows the auxiliary AC circuit allocated to protection-panel service functions. An auxiliary AC distribution diagram identifies the supplies serving room services and control-support equipment. Essential, backed-up and ordinary circuits can have different source paths and operating priorities.

In a switchroom, the lighting, service sockets, charger input and room cooling may be fed from different auxiliary branches. A source change must preserve the identities of loads that require continuity. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Auxiliary AC board” at the input and “Panel service AC” at the output. Service power differs from protective-relay operating power.
